items.html: And it is found that the Malchut of Yetzira of that time was the Trans-Jordan of that time, and the Malchut of the present Beria was then the aspect of Syria, and the six last [Sefirot] of Assiya of that time, which are the six first [Sefirot] of the present Yetzira, were outside the Land — because these were then the aspect of Assiya. And it is known that outside the Land Assiya depends and rules there. And we have already explained that the feet of Adam HaRishon were outside the Land.
